blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Long-horizon embodied interaction requires agents to retain and continually update information about the environment as they observe, act, and encounter change. Yet current agents struggle to maintain such memory reliably. Our analysis traces this limitation to four key deficiencies: weak fine-grained visual memory, unreliable dynamic world-state tracking, failing to record world state revealed by interaction outcomes, and limited generalization from prior experience. However, existing benchmarks do not directly assess these memory capabilities during long-horizon embodied interaction. To address this gap, we introduce EmbodiedMemory-Bench (EMem-Bench) , comprising 2,554 interactive episodes across four task families. EMem-Bench requires agents to build and update memory from interaction history, then use it to complete a later task by acting in the environment. We further present Embodied-Memorizer (EMem) , an external memory system that organizes embodied experience into spatial, event, and scene memories. We also train EMem-8B, an 8B policy that manages and uses these memories. We evaluate a diverse range of open-source and proprietary MLLMs and representative multimodal memory systems. Results show that current models remain weak and uneven across the four challenges. Under matched backbones, EMem achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated memory systems and improves both open-source and proprietary models, while EMem-8B further improves over its backbone.
Project page: https://zju-omniai.github.io/EmbodiedMemoryBench/ .
blocks.zh:
具有长视野的相互作用要求代理人在观察、行动和遇到变化时保留和不断更新有关环境的信息。 然而,现在的特工们却难以可靠地保持这种记忆。 我们的分析将这种局限性追溯到四个关键缺陷:微弱的精细视觉记忆,不可靠的动态世界状态跟踪,未能记录互动结果揭示的世界状态,以及以往经验的有限概括. 然而,现有基准并没有直接评估长期互动过程中的这些记忆能力。 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了“健康记忆-奔驰”(EMEM-Bench),由四个任务家庭的2 554个互动节目组成。 EMem-Bench要求代理从相互作用历史中建立和更新内存,然后用它通过在环境中的行动来完成后期的任务. 我们进一步介绍健美-记忆器(EMem),这是一个外部记忆系统,将经验组织到空间、事件和场景记忆中。 我们还训练EMem-8B,一种管理和使用这些记忆的8B政策. 我们评价多种开源和专有的MLLM和有代表性的多式联运内存系统。 结果表明,目前的模式仍然薄弱,而且四个挑战之间不平衡。 在匹配的骨干下,EMem在被评价的内存系统中实现最佳的整体性能,并同时改进开源模型和专有模型,而EMem-8B则在骨干上进一步改善.

blocks.en: 2 Introduction
blocks.zh: 2 导言

blocks.en: Recent rapid advances in language models have empowered LLM agents to autonomously complete complex, long-horizon tasks in digital environments, often spanning hours or even days, such as developing large-scale software from scratch or conducting online research and writing reports. A key capability underlying this progress is long-term memory, which involves retaining interaction histories, retrieving past information, and reusing experience across tasks.
blocks.zh: 最近语言模型的迅速进步,使LLM代理能够自主地完成数字环境中的复杂,长视距的任务,这些任务往往跨越数小时甚至数天,例如从零开始开发大型软件或进行在线研究和撰写报告. 这一进展背后的一个关键能力是长期记忆,它涉及保留互动历史、检索过去的信息和在各项任务中重新利用经验。

blocks.en: When agents step out of text-centric digital environments into the real 3D physical world , however, the demands on memory become substantially more complex. Text-centric memory primarily retains linguistic information, while multimodal memory extends this to images and videos. As illustrated in Figure 1 , embodied memory must further preserve the causal connections between observations, actions, and feedback : actions change the environment, and their outcomes reveal world states and constraints that may not be directly visible. These interactions unfold over long horizons in environments subject to disturbance and change ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Embodied agents must therefore process cross-modal , lengthy , and noisy interaction histories, extracting useful context and organizing it into concise memory that supports reasoning and subsequent physical interaction.
blocks.zh: 然而,当代理人员走出以文字为中心的数字环境,进入真正的3D物理世界时,对内存的需求就变得更加复杂。 以文字为中心的内存主要保留语言信息,而多式联运内存则将其延伸至图像和视频. 如图1所示,内存必须进一步保持观察、行动和反馈之间的因果联系:行动改变了环境,其结果揭示了可能无法直接看到的世界状态和制约因素。 这些相互作用在受到扰动和变化影响的环境中长期展开(Zhang等人,2025年)。 因此,健全的代理人必须处理交叉模式、冗长和吵闹的相互作用历史,提取有用的上下文,并将其组织成支持推理和随后的物理相互作用的简明记忆。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Comparison of text-centric, multimodal, and embodied memory. Embodied memory connects visual observations, actions, and feedback into causal interaction histories that support subsequent tasks in a changing physical world.
blocks.zh: 图1:文本中心、多式联运和内存的比较。 健美的内存将视觉观测,行动和反馈连接到因果互动历史中,支持在不断变化的物理世界中后续的任务.

blocks.en: Likewise, embodied memory is an indispensable capability for long-horizon interaction in the physical world: an embodied agent that cannot remember where objects were observed, how the environment has changed, or what actions it has previously taken is inevitably reduced to short-sighted behavior driven by immediate perception.
blocks.zh: 同样,内含的记忆是物理世界中长视距相互作用不可或缺的能力:一种内含的能动剂,它无法记起物体被观察到的地方,环境是如何变化的,或者它以前采取的行动,必然会沦为由即时感知驱动的短视行为.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Primary errors in 100 failed EmbodiedBench trajectories from Gemini-3-Flash and Qwen3-VL-32B on EB-ALF and EB-Hab. The four embodied-memory categories account for 91% of failures. Percentages in parentheses indicate the proportion of failures attributed to each error category.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 来自双子座-3-Flash和Qwen3-VL-32B在EB-ALF和EB-Hab上的100个失败的Embody Bench轨迹中的主要错误. 四个体现的记忆类别占失败的91%。 括号中的百分比表示每个错误类别造成的失败比例。

blocks.en:
Recent embodied benchmarks ( Yang et al., 2025a ) show that even the most advanced MLLMs struggle with long-horizon embodied tasks. To investigate this limitation in depth, we manually inspect 100 failed trajectories of Gemini-3-Flash and Qwen3-VL-32B on EmbodiedBench’s EB-ALF and EB-Hab. As shown in Figure 2 , most failures fall into four categories: forgetting fine-grained visual cues (35%), overlooking changes in the environment (18%), failing to record world state revealed by interaction outcomes (31%), and failing to generalize from prior experience (7%). For long-horizon tasks, these four types of failures are so frequent and pervasive (about 91% in total) that even advanced MLLMs and embodied models are not immune to them.
This four typical failures correspond to four essential embodied-memory capabilities in long-horizon interaction: (1) Fine-grained visual memory. Although future tasks are not known in advance, an embodied agent must remember the appearances and locations of the objects it has seen, as any of them may be needed later. (2) Dynamic world-state tracking. In real-world environments, the states of objects may be altered by humans or other robots, so the agent must continually record the latest state of each object. (3) Recording world state revealed by interaction outcomes. Failed grasps, locked cabinets, and unusable receptacles reveal state unavailable to vision; this state must likewise be remembered and constrain later actions. (4) Experience generalization memory. Successes and failures from earlier tasks, together with physical regularities observed along the way, must also be retained and transferred to new tasks.
blocks.zh:
最近包含的基准(Yang等人,2025年a)表明,即使是最先进的MLLMs也与长视距任务相搏。 为了深入调查这一限制,我们手动检查Bench的EB-ALF和EB-Hab上的双子座-3-Flash和Qune3-VL-32B的100个故障轨迹。 如图2所示,大多数失败分为四类:忘记细微的视觉提示(35%),忽略环境的变化(18%),未能记录互动结果揭示的世界状态(31%),以及未能从以往的经验中概括(7%)。 对于长距离任务来说,这四种类型的失败是如此频繁和普遍(总共约91%),以至于甚至先进的MLLM和内含的模型也无法幸免.
这四个典型的失败对应了长视相互作用中四个基本的内含-记忆能力:(1)精细的视觉记忆. 虽然未来的任务事先还不得而知,但一个体现的代理人必须记住它所见到的物体的外观和位置,因为以后可能需要其中的任何一项。 (2)动态世界状态跟踪. 在现实世界环境中,物体的状态可能被人类或其他机器人改变,因此代理人必须不断记录每个物体的最新状态. (3)记录通过互动结果揭示的世界状态. 抓取失败、锁紧的柜子和无法使用的贮器显示无法看到状态;同样必须记住和限制以后的行动。 (4)经验概括记忆. 还必须保留以往任务的成功和失败,以及沿途观察到的实际规律性,并将之转入新的任务。

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduce EmbodiedMemory-Bench (EMem-Bench) , which contains 2,554 carefully designed episodes. Each episode consists of a temporally ordered history of multimodal interactions with the environment ℋ = { o 1 h , … , o N h } \mathcal{H}=\{o^{\mathrm{h}}_{1},\dots,o^{\mathrm{h}}_{N}\} , a target task 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , and a feasible action space 𝒜 \mathcal{A} . The embodied agent must comprehend the given history ℋ \mathcal{H} , implicitly or explicitly extract the information required by 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , and then interact with the environment step by step, generating its own interaction trajectory ( o e 1 : t o^{\mathrm{e}}_{1:t} ) until the task is completed: a t ∼ π ( ⋅ ∣ ℋ , 𝒯 , o 1 : t e , a 1 : t − 1 ) a_{t}\sim\pi\!\left(\cdot\mid\mathcal{H},\mathcal{T},o^{\mathrm{e}}_{1:t},a_{1:t-1}\right) .
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍“健康记忆-奔驰”(EMEM-Bench),其中包含2,554个精心设计的插曲。 每集包含一个按时间顺序排列的与环境H={o 1h,...,o Nh}\mathcal{H}=\{o^{\mathrm{h}}_{1},\dots,o^{\mathrm{h}}_{N},目标任务T\mathcal{T},以及可行的动作空间A\mathcal{A}. 包含的代理必须理解给定的历史 H\ mathcal{H}, 隐含或明确提取 T\ mathcal{T} 所需的信息, 然后一步一步地与环境交互, 生成自己的交互轨迹( o e 1 : t o mathrm{e}}_{1 : t) 直到任务完成: a t ∼( ⋅ H, T , o 1 : t ) : a 1 : t – 1 ) a_{sim\pi\!\ left (\ cdot\ mid\ mathcal{H},\ mathcal{T}, o^{\mathrm{e}}_{1 : t}, a_{1) : t-1}\right) 。 。 。

blocks.en: We design each episode by varying the interaction history ( ℋ \mathcal{H} ) and the target task ( 𝒯 \mathcal{T} ). All tasks are organized into four sub-task families: Passive Observation tests fine-grained visual memory in object-dense views; Dynamic Tracking tests whether the agent remembers changes in object states within the environment; Interaction Failure tests whether world state revealed by interaction outcomes is recorded; and Experience Generalization tests whether regularities learned from recurring experiences transfer to new task scenarios. Figure 3 illustrates the four task families.
blocks.zh: 我们设计每集时都会改变交互历史(H\ mathcal{H})和目标任务(T\mathcal{T}). 所有任务分为四个次级任务家庭: 被动观测测试对象感知视图中精细的视觉内存; 动态跟踪测试代理人是否记得环境内物体状态的变化; 相互作用失败测试是否记录了相互作用结果所揭示的世界状态; 经验概括测试是否从反复发生的经验转移到新的任务情景中吸取规律. 图3说明了四个任务领域。

blocks.en: EMem-Bench differs from current general embodied benchmarks, which either adopt single-turn question-answering task or instruct the agent to explore the environment and execute a given task without any provided context. In contrast, our memory-centric benchmark focuses on an embodied agent’s ability to exploit memory: given offline interaction trajectories, the agent must consolidate them into memory, reason over it, and translate it into effective actions in the environment. Table 1 summarizes this comparison.
blocks.zh: EMem-Bench不同于目前一般包含的基准,这些基准要么采用单回合式的问答任务,要么指示代理人探索环境,在没有规定任何上下文的情况下执行特定任务. 相比之下,我们以记忆为中心的基准侧重于一个体现的代理人利用记忆的能力:由于离线交互轨迹,代理人必须将它们整合成记忆,理性战胜它,并将其转化为环境中的有效行动。 表1总结了这一比较。

blocks.en: Using EMem-Bench, we evaluate 16 leading open-source and proprietary MLLMs together with representative multimodal memory systems. The strongest proprietary model, Gemini-3-Flash, reaches only 64.2% average SR, while all but one of the evaluated open-source models score below 45%. Among 400 sampled failures, 61.3% begin when the model acts on a memory contradicted by its interaction history. These results show that even strong models cannot consistently maintain an accurate memory of the environment they interact with, and that open-source models exhibit large differences across the four task families.
blocks.zh: 使用EMem-Bench,我们评价16个主要的开源和专有的MLLMs以及有代表性的多模式内存系统. 最强的专有模型双子座-3-Flash平均只有64.2%的SR,而除一个外,所有被评价的开源模型都得分低于45%. 在400个抽样失败中,61.3%从模型对一个内存的行为与其交互历史相矛盾时开始. 这些结果表明,即使是强健的模型也无法始终如一地保持与它们互动的环境的准确记忆,开放源代码模型在四个任务家族中表现出巨大的差异.

blocks.en:
In addition, we introduce a simple yet effective embodied memory system, Embodied-Memorizer (EMem) , as a baseline, which organizes multimodal experience through scene , spatial , and event memories , together with an 8B policy trained to write, retrieve, and use these memories. Without task-specific training, EMem improves average SR by 16.4 points on the open-source Mistral-Small-3.1-24B and by 23.6 points on the proprietary GPT-5.4-mini; the trained EMem-8B policy improves over Qwen3-VL-8B by 20.6 points.
Our contributions are as follows: • We identify four typical errors in embodied interaction: forgetting fine-grained visual cues, overlooking environmental changes, failing to record world state revealed by interaction outcomes, and failing to generalize from prior experience—revealing that current MLLMs lack embodied memory required for long-horizon tasks. • We introduce EMem-Bench, a memory-centric benchmark with 2,554 episodes across four task families. Agents must extract information from a given multimodal interaction history, construct the relevant memory, and interact with the environment for task completion. • We systematically evaluate 16 open-source and proprietary MLLMs together with representative multimodal memory systems, revealing persistent limitations across the four memory types. We further present an embodied memory system that organizes interaction trajectories into scene, spatial, and event memories and improves both open-source and proprietary models.
blocks.zh:
此外,我们引入了一个简单而有效的内存系统,即“模拟器”作为基线,它通过场景、空间和事件记忆组织多种模式的经验,以及训练成写、检索和使用这些记忆的8B政策。 没有任务特定培训,EMem在开源Mistral-Small-3.1-24B上平均提高SR16.4分,在专有GPT-5.4-mini上提高23.6分;经过培训的EMem-8B政策比Qune3-VL-8B上提高了20.6分.
• 我们的贡献如下: 我们找出了体现的相互作用的四个典型错误:忘记了细微的视觉提示,忽略了环境变化,没有记录相互作用结果所揭示的世界状态,没有从以往的经验中概括——揭示出目前的MLLM缺乏长期任务所需的内存。 我们引入了EMem-Bench,一个以记忆为中心的基准,在四个任务家族中共2,554集. 代理人必须从特定的多式联运互动历史中提取信息,构建相关的内存,并与环境互动以完成任务。 我们系统地评价16个开放源码和专有的MLLMs以及具有代表性的多式联运内存系统,揭示出四种内存类型的持续局限性。 我们进一步提出了一个内存系统,将互动轨迹组织成场景、空间和事件记忆,并改进开源模式和专有模式。

blocks.zh: 表1:与现有基准的比较。 Vis., Dyn., Int.,和 Exp.分别表示视觉内存,动态跟踪,相互作用衍生状态,以及经验概括. Y标志明确的评价.

blocks.en: Embodied-agent benchmarks. EmbodiedBench evaluates vision-driven agents across action levels. FindingDory and LMEE-Bench use visual history for navigation ( Yadav et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) ; SpaMEM tests spatial-state revision ( Liao et al., 2026 ) ; and WorldLines evaluates state question answering and planning over multi-day traces ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . These benchmarks introduce memory within individual tasks, whereas EMem-Bench evaluates embodied memory jointly across interactive episodes.
blocks.zh: 良好代理基准。 健美的奔驰评价了整个行动层面的愿景驱动剂. FindingDory和LMEE-Bench使用视觉历史进行导航(Yadav等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年a),SpaMEM测试空间态修订(Liao等人,2026年),WorldLines通过多日跟踪评价状态问题回答和规划(张等人,2026年). 这些基准在个别任务中引入了内存,而EMem-Bench则通过互动事件共同评价内存。

blocks.en: Agent memory. LoCoMo and LongMemEval evaluate memory over multi-session histories ( Maharana et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) . MemoryAgentBench studies retrieval and test-time learning ( Hu et al., 2026 ) ; Evo-Memory studies experience reuse ( Wei et al., 2026 ) ; and WorldMemArena evaluates memory writing, maintenance, retrieval, and use ( Liu et al., 2026a ) . Unlike EMem-Bench, these benchmarks do not require remembered information to guide subsequent embodied interaction. Additional related work is discussed in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 特工记忆. LoCoMo和LongMemEval评价多会历史的记忆(Maharana等人,2024年;Wu等人,2025年)。 MemoryAgent Bench研究检索和测试时间学习(Hu等人,2026年);Evo-Memory研究体验再利用(Wei等人,2026年);WorldMemarena评价记忆书写,维护,检索和使用(Liu等人,2026a年). 与EMem-Bench不同,这些基准不需要记忆中的信息来指导后续的内含互动. 附录A讨论了其他相关工作。

blocks.en: 4.1 Task Definition
blocks.zh: 4.1 任务定义

blocks.en: EMem-Bench evaluates whether embodied agents can maintain a world state over long-term interaction. Each episode is defined by a temporally ordered history of multimodal interactions ℋ = { o 1 h , … , o N h } \mathcal{H}=\{o^{\mathrm{h}}_{1},\ldots,o^{\mathrm{h}}_{N}\} , a target task 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , and a feasible action space 𝒜 \mathcal{A} . The history contains memory evidence needed for the target task. After receiving 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , the model must retrieve the relevant evidence from ℋ \mathcal{H} and use it to complete the task through continued interaction with the environment. At execution step t t , the model selects an action according to a t ∼ π ( ⋅ ∣ ℋ , 𝒯 , o 1 : t e , a 1 : t − 1 ) , a t ∈ 𝒜 , a_{t}\sim\pi\!\left(\cdot\mid\mathcal{H},\mathcal{T},o^{\mathrm{e}}_{1:t},a_{1:t-1}\right),\qquad a_{t}\in\mathcal{A}, (1) where o e 1 : t o^{\mathrm{e}}_{1:t} denotes the observations received during task execution. An episode is successful when the resulting interaction trajectory reaches an environment state that satisfies 𝒯 \mathcal{T} . The benchmark is organized into four task families.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Construction pipeline of EMem-Bench. Each episode combines a grounded scene, a task-specific memory cue, and distractor trajectories, followed by automated validation and manual review.

blocks.en: 4.2 Task Families
blocks.zh: 4.2 任务家庭

blocks.en: The four task families primarily differ in how ℋ \mathcal{H} and 𝒯 \mathcal{T} are constructed: ℋ \mathcal{H} determines what type of information must be remembered, while 𝒯 \mathcal{T} determines how that information must be used during later interaction.
blocks.zh: 四个任务家族在构建 H\ mathcal{H} 和 T\ mathcal{T} 的方式上主要不同 : H\ mathcal{H} 确定必须记住哪类信息, 而 T\ mathcal{T} 确定以后的交互中必须如何使用这些信息 。

blocks.en: Passive Observation. This family evaluates whether an agent can build fine-grained visual memory in an object-dense scene. The interaction history contains a task trajectory in an object-dense scene, during which the later target object appears. The subsequent task asks the agent to find that object. In Figure 3 , the laptop appears among several objects on the coffee table; navigating to the chair instead shows that the agent failed to retain its location.
blocks.zh: 被动观察. 这个家族评价一个特工是否能够在物体密集的场景中建立精细的视觉记忆. 交互历史中包含一个对象密集场景中的任务轨迹,在此期间会出现后来的目标对象. 随后的任务要求代理商找到该对象. 在图3中,笔记本电脑出现在咖啡桌上的几个物体中;在椅子上航行显示,该代理人未能保留其位置。

blocks.en: Dynamic Tracking. This family evaluates whether an agent can keep its world state current as object locations and states change over time. The interaction history records an object before and after its location or state changes. The subsequent task requires the agent to act on the latest state rather than an outdated observation. In Figure 3 , the book moves from the bed through the box to the desk amid distractor observations; returning to the bed shows that the agent failed to update the world state stored in memory.
blocks.zh: 动态跟踪。 这个家族评价一个代理是否能够随着对象位置和状态随时间变化而保持其世界状态. 交互历史记录一个对象在其位置或状态变化前后. 之后的任务要求代理人对最新状态采取行动,而不是过时的观察. 在图3中,本作从床通过盒子移动到桌上,在分心器观察中;返回床显示代理机未能更新存储在记忆中的世界状态.

blocks.en: Interaction Failure. This family evaluates whether an agent can retain world state revealed by interaction outcomes. The interaction history contains an attempted physical action and its failure feedback, which reveals a visually inaccessible state such as a locked drawer or blocked receptacle. The subsequent task presents several possible interaction targets and requires the agent to avoid the one shown to be unusable and choose a viable alternative. In Figure 3 , a failed attempt reveals that the top drawer is locked; trying it again instead of the usable bottom drawer shows that the agent failed to record the locked state revealed by the interaction.
blocks.zh: 互动失败。 这个家族评价一个代理人是否能够保留互动结果揭示的世界状态. 互动历史中包含一个尝试的物理动作及其故障反馈,揭示了一个视觉无法进入的状态,如锁紧的抽屉或被屏蔽的贮器. 之后的任务提出了几个可能的交互目标,要求代理人避免显示为无法使用的目标,并选择一个可行的替代品. 在图3中,一次失败的尝试显示顶部抽屉是锁上的;再次尝试而不是可用的底部抽屉显示,代理机未能记录到相互作用所揭示的锁定状态.

blocks.en: Experience Generalization. This family evaluates whether an agent can transfer a regularity learned from past events to a new object. The interaction history contains several cases involving different objects, each showing an initially incorrect action and a correction. The subsequent task introduces a new object from the same category that did not appear in the histories and requires the agent to apply their shared regularity. In Figure 3 , corrections place a knife and a spoon in a drawer before the agent encounters a fork; placing the fork on the table shows that the shared placement regularity did not transfer to the new object.
blocks.zh: 经验通论. 这个家族评价一个代理人是否能够将从过去事件学到的规律性转移到一个新的对象. 交互历史包含几个涉及不同对象的案例,每个案例都显示了最初不正确的动作和修正. 随后的任务引入了同一类别中未出现在历史中的新对象,并要求代理人应用其共享的规律性. 在图3中,更正在代理遇到叉前将一把刀和勺子放在抽屉中;将叉子放在桌子上表明共享的放置规律没有转移到新对象上.

blocks.en: 4.3 Interaction-History Construction
blocks.zh: 4.3 互动-历史建设

blocks.en: We construct the interaction history provided to the model in four stages: selecting a multi-room environment, creating a task-relevant memory cue, inserting distractor trajectories, and validating the resulting trajectory. Figure 4 summarizes how this model input is constructed.
blocks.zh: 我们把提供给模型的相互作用历史分为四个阶段:选择一个多室环境,创建一个与任务相关的内存提示,插入分心器轨迹,验证由此产生的轨迹。 图4概述了这一模型投入的构建方式。

blocks.en: Selecting rooms. AI2-THOR ( Kolve et al., 2022 ) scenes contain only a single room, so we compose scenes of different room types into a virtual home and extend the action space with LeaveRoom , EnterRoom , and MoveToRoom . The state of room is restored when the agent re-enters it. ProcTHOR ( Deitke et al., 2022 ) already provides multi-room homes; we filter them for room connectivity, navigable space, object visibility, and executable interactions. From each retained environment, we designate a cue room that supports the required memory relation and use the remaining connected rooms for unrelated activity and the later target task.
blocks.zh: 选择房间。 AI2-THOR(Kolve et al., 2022年)的场景只包含一个单间,因此我们把不同房间类型的场景编成一个虚拟的家庭,并用LeaveRoom, EnterRoom,以及MoveToRoom来扩展动作空间. 代理人再入室时恢复房间状态. ProcTHOR(Deitke等人,2022年)已经提供了多室住宅;我们过滤这些住宅,用于房间连接、可导航空间、物体可见度以及可执行的相互作用。 从每个保留的环境中,我们指定一个提示室,支持所需的内存关系,并将其余连接的房间用于不相关的活动和后来的目标任务.

blocks.en: Constructing the memory cue. We define a memory cue as an interaction trajectory containing the information that the agent must remember to complete the target task. We construct a different memory cue for each task family. For Passive Observation, we select an object that is visible in the agent’s current view, then use it as the memory cue for a later retrieval task. For Dynamic Tracking, we select an object, change its location or state in the simulator, and make the later task depend on the updated state. For Interaction Failure, we execute a failed action whose feedback reveals an object state, and make the later task depend on that state. For Experience Generalization, Claude-4.6-Sonnet ( Anthropic, 2026 ) receives structured scene information and outputs a structured experience containing an underlying regularity, several correction cases, and a target task. We then ground the generated experience in concrete scene objects and execute the resulting interaction trajectory in the simulator.
blocks.zh: 正在构建内存提示 。 我们将内存提示定义为包含代理完成目标任务必须记住的信息的互动轨迹. 我们为每个任务家族构建不同的记忆提示。 对于被动观察,我们选择一个在代理当前视图中可见的对象,然后将其作为后期检索任务的内存提示. 对于动态跟踪,我们选择一个对象,改变其在模拟器中的位置或状态,使后期任务依赖于更新状态. 对于交互失败,我们执行一个失败的动作,其反馈揭示了对象状态,并且使后期任务依赖于该状态. 关于经验概论,Claude-4.6-Sonnet(Anthropic,2026年)收到结构化现场信息,并输出包含基本规律性的结构化经验,几例矫正案例,以及一项目标任务. 然后我们把生成的经验 放在具体的场景物体上 并在模拟器中执行产生的相互作用轨迹

blocks.en: Injecting distractor trajectories. A PDDL planner ( Aeronautiques et al., 1998 ) generates unrelated trajectories before and after the memory cue based on the current scene and agent state. These trajectories vary where the cue appears in the episode and place other rooms and tasks between the cue and the target task. We discard any trajectory that touches critical objects, reveals the answer, changes the state required by the target task, or cannot be executed.
blocks.zh: 注射分散器轨迹. 一个PDDL规划器(Aeronautiques等人,1998年)根据当前场景和代理状态在内存提示前后产生不相关的轨迹. 这些轨迹在剧集中出现的提示位置各有不同,并在提示和目标任务之间放置其他房间和任务. 我们丢弃任何触及关键对象的轨道,揭示答案,改变目标任务所要求的状态,或者无法执行.

blocks.en: Validating and reviewing each episode. Automated checks ensure that the scene is navigable, the required interactions can be executed, and the target task can be completed. They also verify that the decisive evidence appears in the earlier experience without being revealed in the distractor trajectories. We then manually inspect every candidate that passes these checks and remove episodes with ambiguous instructions, implausible trajectories, or cues that do not uniquely support the intended action. This process rejected 143 episodes; all 2,554 retained episodes pass both automated execution checks and manual screening.
blocks.zh: 验证和审查每集. 自动检查确保场景可通航,所需互动可以执行,目标任务可以完成. 他们还证实,决定性的证据出现在早先的经验中,但没有在分散注意力的轨迹中暴露出来。 然后我们手动检查每一个通过这些检查的候选人, 并删除一些插曲, 带有模棱两可的指示, 难以置信的轨迹, 或提示, 这个过程拒绝了143集;所有2,554个保留片段都通过自动执行检查和人工筛选.

blocks.en: 4.4 Benchmark Statistics and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.4 基准统计和评价

blocks.zh: 图5:互动-历史长度和点对点-任务距离的分布.

blocks.en: EMem-Bench contains 2,554 episodes: 1,036 Passive Observation, 1,052 Dynamic Tracking, 263 Interaction Failure, and 203 Experience Generalization. Across all four families, the benchmark spans 1,118 scenes, 125 visible object types, 83 target types, and 33 receptacle types. Figure 5 shows the interaction-history length and task composition together with cue-to-target-task distance. Visible-object density at the cue and room/scene transitions are reported in the appendix.
blocks.zh: EMem-Bench包含2,554集:被动观察1,036集,动态跟踪1,052集,互动失败263集,经验概括203集. 在所有四个家庭中,基准范围为1 118个场景、125个可见物体类型、83个目标类型和33个贮器类型。 图5显示交互-历史长度和任务构成以及提示-目标-任务距离。 提示处的可见物体密度和房间/场景过渡情况在附录中报告。

blocks.en: Evaluation metrics. Predicted action sequences are executed in the simulator, and an episode is successful only when the resulting environment reaches the target terminal state. We report success rate (SR) for each task family and use their equally weighted mean as the overall score, preventing the two larger families from dominating the evaluation. Full benchmark statistics are provided in the appendix.

blocks.en: 5 Our Method: Embodied-Memorizer
blocks.zh: 5 我们的方法:健美-记忆器

blocks.en: EMem is an external memory system that continually organizes and updates world state during embodied interaction. Figure 6 provides an overview of the EMem architecture.
blocks.zh: EMem是一个外部记忆系统,在包含的相互作用中不断组织和更新世界状态. 图6概述了EMem架构.

blocks.en: 5.1 Three Complementary Memories
blocks.zh: 5.1 三个补充记忆

blocks.en: Spatial memory. Spatial memory maintains an entity graph that tracks the locations and states of objects. New observations and feedback update the corresponding records so that the graph reflects the latest known state of each object. For example, when a book is moved from the bed to the desk, spatial memory replaces the outdated relation to the bed and returns the desk as the book’s current location.
blocks.zh: 空间记忆. 空间内存维持一个跟踪物体位置和状态的实体图. 新的观察和反馈更新了相应的记录,使图表能够反映每个对象的最新已知状态. 例如,当一本书从床移到书桌时,空间记忆会取代与床的过时关系,并将书桌作为书的当前位置返回.

blocks.en: Event memory. Event memory preserves actions, environment feedback, and human corrections in temporal order. It can also summarize a pattern across several corrections and retrieve that pattern when the agent encounters a related new object. For example, when the agent tries to open the top drawer and learns that it is locked, event memory preserves the attempt and its outcome so that the agent can avoid repeating the same action later.
blocks.zh: 事件记忆. 事件记忆按照时间顺序保存动作,环境反馈和人类矫正. 它还可以概括一个跨越几个更正的图案,当代理遇到相关的新对象时检索这个图案. 例如,当代理试图打开顶端抽屉并得知其被锁定时,事件内存会保存尝试及其结果,以便代理者日后可以避免重复同样的动作.

blocks.en: Scene memory. Scene memory associates objects and interactions with their scenes, preventing confusion between same-named entities in different rooms. For example, when mugs appear in both the kitchen and the bedroom, scene memory binds each mug and its interactions to the corresponding room, allowing the correct instance to be retrieved.
blocks.zh: 场景记忆. 场景记忆将物体和与他们的场景的互动联系起来,防止了不同房间中同名实体之间的混淆. 例如,当杯子同时出现在厨房和卧室时,场景记忆会将每个杯子及其相互作用绑在相应的房间,从而可以收回正确的实例.

blocks.en: 5.2 Operating the Memory Loop
blocks.zh: 5.2 运行内存循环

blocks.en: Figure 6: EMem architecture. Scene memory stores visual context, spatial memory maintains current object states, and event memory records interactions and reusable experience.
blocks.zh: 图6:EMem架构. 场景内存存储视觉上下文,空间内存保持当前对象状态,事件内存记录相互作用和可重复使用的经验.

blocks.en: EMem provides write and query interfaces for each memory. During interaction, the model stores visual observations, environmental changes, action outcomes, and corrections. For a target task, it queries one or more memories and combines the returned information with the current observation to generate a complete action sequence. Execution produces the next observation and feedback, allowing memory to be updated as interaction continues. The complete tool interface and retrieval procedure are provided in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: EMem为每个内存提供书写和查询接口. 在互动期间,模型存储视觉观测、环境变化、行动结果和校正。 对于目标任务,它查询一个或多个记忆,并将返回的信息与当前观测结合起来,生成完整的动作序列. 执行产生下一次的观察和反馈,使得内存能够随着互动的持续更新. 完整的工具接口和检索程序载于附录B。

blocks.en: We use supervised fine-tuning to teach three decisions: what to write from the current observation, which memories to query for the target task, and how to generate an action sequence from the retrieved information. Training trajectories are generated from the ProcTHOR training split, with a teacher model providing supervision. Fine-tuning Qwen3-VL-8B produces EMem-8B ; data construction and full training details are provided in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 我们使用有监督的微调来教导三个决定:从当前观察中写出什么,哪些记忆来查询目标任务,以及如何从检索到的信息中生成动作序列. 培训轨迹由ProcTHOR培训分拆产生,由教师模式提供监督. 微调 Qune3-VL-8B 生产 EMem-8B ; 数据构建和全部培训细节见附录B 。

blocks.en: 6 Experiments
blocks.zh: 6 实验

blocks.en: 6.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 6.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Baselines. Our general-purpose open-source baselines include Qwen3-VL ( Bai et al., 2025 ) , InternVL3 ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) , Ovis2 ( Lu et al., 2025 ) , Qwen3.6 ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , and Mistral-Small-3.1 ( Mistral AI, 2025 ) . The embodied MLLMs include RynnBrain ( Dang et al., 2026 ) , Cambrian-S ( Yang et al., 2025b ) , RoboBrain2.5 ( Tan et al., 2026 ) , MiMo-Embodied ( Hao et al., 2026 ) , and the Robotics-ER 1.5 ( Gemini Robotics Team and others, 2025 ) . Our general-purpose proprietary baselines include GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.4-mini ( Singh et al., 2026 ) , Gemini-2.5-Pro ( Comanici et al., 2025 ) , and Gemini-3-Flash ( Google, 2025 ) . To fit episodes within the context, the full_context condition retains the complete trajectory in text form and only the final visual observation. For the memory-system comparison, we fix GPT-5.4-mini as the backbone and evaluate MIRIX ( Wang and Chen, 2025 ) , MemVerse ( Liu et al., 2026b ) , TeleMem ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , MMA ( Lu et al., 2026 ) , and EMem.
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们的通用开源基线包括:Quen3-VL(Bai等人,2025年),InternVL3(Zhu等人,2025年),Ovis2(Lu等人,2025年),Quen3.6(Quen Team,2026年)和Mistral-Small-3.1(Mistral AI,2025年). 包含的MLLMs包括RynnBrain(Dang等人,2026年),Cambrian-S. (Yang等人,2025年b),RoboBraine2.5(Tan等人,2026年),MiMo-Embody。 (Hao等人,2026年),以及机器人-ER 1.5(双子机器人队等,2025年). 我们的普通用途专有基线包括GPT-5.4和GPT-5.4-mini(Singh等人,2026年),双子座2.5-Pro(Comanici等人,2025年)和双子座-3-Flash(Google,2025年)。 为了在上下文中匹配事件,完整_文本条件保留了完整轨道的文本形式,仅保留最终的视觉观察. 对于记忆系统比较,我们固定了GPT-5.4-mini作为骨干并评价MIRIX(王和陈,2025年),MemVerse(刘等人,2026b),TeleMem(陈等人,2026年),MMA (Lu等人,2026年),和EMem.

blocks.en: 6.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 6.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 2: Full results on EMem-Bench (%). Average denotes the mean across the four task families. Parenthesized gray values show absolute changes from the corresponding full-context backbone. Underlining marks the best result within each setting, and bold marks the best result overall. Robotics-ER 1.5 ∗ is evaluated on a 10% subset because of API service instability.
blocks.zh: 表2:EMem-Bench的全部结果(%)。 平均数是指四个任务家庭的平均值。 括号的灰色值显示从相应的完整文本主干线的绝对变化. 各种背景中,强调是最佳成果,而大胆是总体最佳成果。 由于API服务不稳定,对10%的子集进行了机器人-ER 1.5*的评价。

blocks.en: Overall performance. As shown in Table 2 , current models still struggle on EMem-Bench: Gemini-3-Flash, the strongest full-context model, reaches only 64.2% average SR. Most models exhibit markedly uneven profiles across the four task families; for example, Qwen3-VL-32B obtains 20.3% SR on Dynamic Tracking but 63.1% on Experience Generalization. Stronger models, in contrast, perform well across all four families rather than excelling on only one, indicating that these abilities form complementary components of long-horizon embodied interaction.
blocks.zh: 总体表现. 如表2所示,目前的模型仍然在EMem-Bench上挣扎:双子座-3-Flash,最强的全文本模型,平均只有64.2%的SR. 大多数模型在四个任务家族中表现出明显不平衡的特征;例如,Qune3-VL-32B在动态跟踪方面获得20.3%的SR,而在经验概括方面获得63.1%的SR。 相比之下,较强的模式在所有四个家庭都表现良好,而不是只表现在一个家庭,这表明这些能力是长期互动的互补组成部分。

blocks.en: Embodied reasoning models. Specialization for embodied or spatial reasoning does not consistently translate into effective memory use over long-horizon interaction. RynnBrain-8B and RoboBrain2.5-8B-NV obtain only 3.6% and 20.0% average SR, both below the Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct at 25.4%. Cambrian-S-7B reaches only 0.8%. MiMo-Embodied-7B reaches 38.8%, and Robotics-ER 1.5 reaches 52.4%, yet neither surpasses the strongest general-purpose open model. These results indicate that specialization for spatial perception, embodied grounding, or robot planning alone does not equip a model to preserve, revise, and act on world state throughout extended interaction.
blocks.zh: 健康的推理模型。 具体化或空间推理的专业化,在长视野的相互作用中并没有一致地转化为有效的内存使用. RynnBrain-8B和RoboBrain2.5-8B-NV只获得3.6%和20.0%的平均SR,均低于Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct的25.4%. Cambrian-S-7B只达到0.8%. MiMo-Embody-7B达到38.8%,机器人-ER 1.5达到52.4%,但两者均没有超过最强的通用开放模式. 这些结果表明,空间感知的专业化、体现的地面定位或机器人规划不能使模型在整个扩展的相互作用中保存、修订和针对世界状态采取行动。

blocks.en: Effectiveness of EMem. EMem achieves the best overall result, reaching 58.9% average SR, 21.1 points above the strongest alternative, TeleMem, while reducing ERR by 11.4 points. Its gains are not limited to one backbone: EMem improves average SR by 10.8, 14.1, and 16.4 points on the three open-source backbones, respectively, and by 23.6 points on the proprietary GPT-5.4-mini. Training Qwen3-VL-8B to write, retrieve, and use the memories provides a further 9.8-point gain over applying EMem to the frozen backbone, showing that learning the memory loop further strengthens the model’s use of external memory.
blocks.zh: EMem的有效性. EMem取得了最佳的整体结果,平均SR达到58.9%,比最强的替代品TeleMem高21.1分,同时将ERR减少11.4分. 其收益不限于一个支柱: EMem在3个开源骨干上分别提高了平均SR的10.8,14.1和16.4分,在专有GPT-5.4-mini上提高了23.6分. Qune3-VL-8B的写作,检索,使用记忆培训比将EMem应用到冷冻骨干上还提供了9.8分的收益,表明学习记忆循环进一步加强了模型对外部记忆的利用.

blocks.en: 6.3 Does More Visual History Help?
blocks.zh: 6.3 更多视觉历史有帮助吗?

blocks.en: Can EMem-Bench be solved by simply appending more historical observations to the model context? We test this with GPT-5.4-mini on a fixed 800-episode subset, with 200 episodes per task family. Both conditions retain the complete textual history and the current RGB observation. The expanded condition additionally supplies as many historical RGB observations as the remaining context budget permits, preserving their temporal order. The target tasks and action budget remain unchanged.
blocks.zh: 仅仅在模型上下文中附加更多的历史观察就可以解决EMem-Bench? 我们用GPT-5.4-mini测试这个 固定的800集子集,每个任务家族有200集。 这两个条件都保留了完整的文字历史和目前的RGB观察. 扩大的条件额外提供了与剩余上下文预算所允许的同样多的历史RGB观测数据,维持了时间顺序。 目标任务和行动预算保持不变。

blocks.en: Table 3: Expanding historical visual context on the same 800 episodes with GPT-5.4-mini. Average SR equally weights the four task families. Input tokens are per-episode means; model-step latency excludes simulator rendering.
blocks.zh: 表3:用GPT-5.4-mini在相同800集上扩展历史视觉背景. 平均斯洛伐克共和国对四个任务家庭同等加权。 输入符是每集的表示;模型-步骤时空排除模拟器渲染.

blocks.en: Table 3 shows that appending historical images reduces average SR from 36.6% to 26.2%, a paired decrease of 10.4 points, while increasing input tokens by 4.9 × 4.9\times and model-step latency by 9.5 × 9.5\times . Performance declines in every history-length quartile. These results demonstrate that EMem-Bench cannot be solved by simply enlarging the raw multimodal context . Effective memory requires recovering and using task-relevant evidence across a long interaction history; simply accumulating more observations does not resolve this challenge. Appendix D.2 provides the image-selection procedure and detailed task-family results.
blocks.zh: 表3显示,附件历史图像将平均SR从36.6%降低到26.2%,对数降低10.4分,同时将输入符增加4.9×4.9分,模式步骤延迟9.5×9.5分。 每个历史长度的四分位数的性能下降. 这些结果表明,仅通过扩大原始多式联运背景无法解决EMem-Bench问题。 有效的记忆需要在整个漫长的互动历史中恢复和使用与任务相关的证据;仅仅积累更多的观察并不能解决这一挑战。 附录D.2提供了图像选择程序和详细的家庭任务结果。

blocks.en: 6.4 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 6.4 读取研究

blocks.en: Table 4 uses GPT-5.4-mini as the fixed backbone and disables one memory at a time while keeping the other two active.
blocks.zh: 表4使用GPT-5.4-mini作为固定骨干,一次禁用一个内存,同时保留另外两个活动.

blocks.en: Table 4: Ablation of the three memories in EMem.
blocks.zh: 表4:EMem中三个记忆的缩写.

blocks.en: Removing any memory reduces average SR, showing that all three contribute substantially to the full system. The task-wise drops reveal distinct roles: Dynamic Tracking depends most on spatial memory; Interaction Failure and Experience Generalization depend most on event memory; and Passive Observation depends most on scene memory.
blocks.zh: 移除任何内存都会降低平均SR,显示这三者都为整个系统做出了重大贡献. 任务级的下降揭示了不同的角色: 动态跟踪(Dynamic Tracking)主要依赖于空间内存; 相互作用失败与经验概括主要依赖于事件内存; 被动观测主要依赖于场景内存.

blocks.en: 6.5 Cross-Benchmark Generalization
blocks.zh: 6.5 双本标记通用

blocks.en: The EB-ALF suite of EmbodiedBench tests transfer to general embodied execution; MMMU-Pro ( Yue et al., 2025 ) evaluates general multimodal understanding; BLINK ( Fu et al., 2024 ) tests fine-grained visual perception; and HallusionBench ( Guan et al., 2024 ) evaluates robustness to visual illusion and language hallucination.
blocks.zh: EB-ALF套装的Embody Bench测试转移到一般的内含执行中;MMMU-Pro(Yue等人,2025年)评价一般的多模式理解;BLINK(Fu等人,2024年)测试精致的视觉感知;和Halusion Bench(Guan等人,2024年)评价对视觉幻觉和语言幻觉的强度.

blocks.en: Table 5: Cross-benchmark generalization results.
blocks.zh: 表5:跨基准通用结果。

blocks.en: Table 5 compares the base Qwen3-VL-8B with EMem-8B across all four benchmarks. EMem-8B improves average SR on EB-ALF by 5.0 points and macro accuracy on BLINK by 1.3 points. It also gains 0.5 points on MMMU-Pro, while remaining comparable on HallusionBench with a 0.4-point decrease. These results show that memory-operation training transfers most strongly to interactive embodied execution, also improves fine-grained visual perception, and preserves general multimodal perception and reasoning.
blocks.zh: 表5对所有四个基准的基数Qune3-VL-8B与EMem-8B进行了比较。 EMem-8B在EB-ALF上的平均SR提高5.0分,在BLINK上宏观精确度提高1.3分. 它还在MMMU-Pro上获得0.5分,而哈卢斯·本奇则保持了0.4分的下降。 这些结果表明,记忆操作培训最有力地转移到交互式的内在执行,也改善了精细的视觉感知,并保留了一般的多式联运感知和推理.

blocks.en: 6.6 Failure Analysis
blocks.zh: 6.6 失败分析

blocks.en: Figure 7: Error distribution of GPT-5.4-mini failures.
blocks.zh: 图7:GPT-5.4-mini故障的错误分布.

blocks.en: We analyze 400 failed GPT-5.4-mini episodes under the full-context setting, sampling 100 from each task family. A memory-use error occurs when the agent’s behavior conflicts with earlier evidence, such as relying on an outdated location or disregarding a learned correction. A contextual reasoning error occurs when the relevant history is available but but the agent fails to interpret or use it. For example, the agent may see that a KeyChain and a CreditCard were corrected to the same location but fail to infer that the same rule applies to a Watch. An action error occurs when the target object and relation are correct but the action sequence goes wrong. For example, the agent may select correct object and receptacle but fail to open the receptacle before placing the object.
blocks.zh: 我们分析400个失败的GPT-5.4-mini事件 在全文本设置下,从每个任务家族抽取100个样本. 当代理的行为与先前的证据相冲突时,如依赖过时的位置或无视已学到的校正,就会发生内存使用错误. 当存在相关历史但代理人未能解释或使用时,会出现背景推理错误。 例如,代理人可能会看到KeyChain和CreditCard被更正到同一个地点,但未能推断同一规则适用于Watch. 当目标对象和关系正确但动作序列出错时,会发生动作错误. 例如,代理人可以选择正确的物体和贮器,但在放置物体之前没有打开贮器。

blocks.en: Figure 7 reveals distinct failure patterns across task families. Memory-use errors dominate Passive Observation, Dynamic Tracking, and Experience Generalization. Their concentration in Dynamic Tracking is revealing: the difficulty is not retaining more history, but replacing outdated state with the latest evidence. Interaction Failure shows a different pattern. Most failures arise from contextual reasoning, indicating that avoiding a previously failed interaction does not necessarily lead to a revised decision. Action errors remain uncommon across all four families, suggesting that the primary bottleneck lies before action generation. Overall, current agents struggle both to maintain the right state from experience and to reason over that state in the current task.
blocks.zh: 图7显示了各个任务家庭明显的失败模式。 记忆使用错误主导被动观察,动态跟踪,以及经验概括. 他们集中在动态跟踪中是揭示的:困难不是保留更多的历史,而是用最新的证据来取代过时的状态. 交互失败显示不同的模式 。 多数失败来自背景推理,表明避免先前失败的互动并不一定导致修订决定。 在所有四个家庭中,行动错误仍然罕见,这表明主要瓶颈在于行动产生之前。 总体而言,目前的代理人在目前的任务中既要保持正确的状态,又要保持合理的状态。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We introduce EMem-Bench, which evaluates fine-grained visual memory, dynamic world-state tracking, recording world state through interaction, and experience generalization through four executable task families. We further present Embodied-Memorizer, which organizes multimodal experience through spatial, event, and scene memory and trains an agent to write, retrieve, and use these memories during interaction. Experiments show that current MLLMs still struggle to maintain and reuse world state over long-term interaction, while EMem improves memory-guided behavior.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了EMem-Bench,它评价精细的视觉记忆,动态的世界状态跟踪,通过互动记录世界状态,通过四个可执行的任务家族体验概括. 我们进一步介绍健美-记忆器,它通过空间、事件和场景记忆组织多模式体验,并训练一名代理人员在互动过程中写作、检索和使用这些记忆。 实验显示,目前的MLLM仍然在长期互动中挣扎维持和再利用世界状态,而EMem则改善内存制导行为.

blocks.en: Appendix A Extended Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录A 扩大的相关工作

blocks.en: History-aware embodied benchmarks. Recent embodied benchmarks increasingly incorporate historical observations, prior interactions, or stateful trajectories into specific task settings. STARBench couples temporal recall with spatial action in open-world object retrieval ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . RoboMME evaluates temporal, spatial, object, and procedural memory in long-horizon manipulation, while RoboMemArena extends robotic evaluation to longer trajectories, composed subtasks, and paired real-world tasks ( Dai et al., 2026 ; Lei et al., 2026 ) . RoboMME-Interference further measures how retrieval degrades as unrelated sessions accumulate between a relevant demonstration and the query ( Rathi, 2026 ) . eMEM-Bench organizes ProcTHOR probes around source monitoring, interference, and context-dependent retrieval ( Rasheed and Kabtoul, 2026 ) . Sequential embodied question answering also shows that carrying an occupancy map or unstructured history across questions does not preserve the visual-semantic state needed for later decisions ( Cai et al., 2026 ) . Together with FindingDory, LMEE-Bench, SpaMEM, WorldLines, and WorldMemArena ( Yadav et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Liao et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026a ) , these benchmarks test historical information within navigation, manipulation, question answering, or state reconstruction. EMem-Bench instead organizes complementary memory demands within a single interactive evaluation.
blocks.zh: 具有历史认识的基准。 最近体现的基准越来越多地将历史观察、先前的相互作用或状态的轨迹纳入具体的任务环境。 STAR Bench夫妇在开放世界的物体检索中通过空间动作进行时间召回(Chen等人,2025年)。 RoboMME在长视操纵中评价时间,空间,物体,和程序记忆,而RoboMemarena则将机器人评价扩展到更长的轨道,由子任务组成,并配对现实世界的任务(Dai等人,2026年;Lei等人,2026年). RoboMME-Interference进一步衡量检索在相关演示和查询之间积累的不相关的会话中如何降解(Rathi, 2026 ). eMEM-Bench组织 ProcTHOR探测器围绕源头监测,干扰,以及依赖上下文的检索(Rasheed and Kabtoul, 2026). 附带的问题回答也表明,携带一个占用图或无结构的历史跨越问题并不能保持以后决定所需的视觉语义状态(Cai等人,2026年)。 与FindingDory、LMEE-Bench、SpaMEM、WorldLines和WorldMemArena合作 (Yadav等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年a;Liao等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026年;Liu等人,2026年a),这些基准测试了导航、操纵、回答问题或国家重建范围内的历史信息。 EMem-Bench则在一次互动评价中组织互补的内存需求.

blocks.en: Related long-horizon settings. 3DMem-Bench combines embodied tasks, question answering, and captioning to study long-term spatial-temporal reasoning, while 3DLLM-Mem selectively fuses features from past observations for reasoning and action ( Hu et al., 2025 ) . GOAT-Bench studies lifelong navigation through sequences of category, language, and image goals and analyzes the role of scene representations across successive targets ( Khanna et al., 2024 ) . OST-Bench evaluates online spatio-temporal understanding from observations gathered during active exploration, including how performance changes as the exploration horizon grows ( Lin et al., 2025 ) . PersONAL evaluates navigation and object grounding from user-specific object–owner associations ( Ziliotto et al., 2025 ) . Together, these benchmarks introduce long-range dependence through spatial-temporal reasoning, lifelong navigation, scene understanding, or personalized grounding. EMem-Bench adopts a different organizing view: whether information acquired during interaction is maintained, updated, and reused when later environment actions depend on it, with separate executable task families for fine-grained visual recall, dynamic state revision, interaction-revealed state, and experience transfer.
blocks.zh: 相关长视野设置. 3DMem-Bench将包含的任务、问答和标题结合起来,研究长期空间-时空推理,而3DLLM-Mem则有选择地将过去观察中的特征引信,用于推理和行动(Hu等人,2025年)。 GOAT-Bench通过分类,语言和图像目标的序列研究终生导航,并分析场景表现在连续目标间的作用(Khanna等人,2024年). OST-Bench通过在积极探索过程中收集的观测结果,包括随着探索视野的增长,对在线时空理解进行评估(Lin等人,2025年)。 PersONAL从用户特定对象的所有人协会(Zilotto等人,2025年)评价导航和物体搁浅情况。 这些基准共同通过空间-时空推理、终生导航、场景理解或个性化地面引入远程依赖。 EMem-Bench采用了不同的组织观点:当后期环境行动依赖于它时,在互动过程中获得的信息是否得到维护、更新和再利用,是否有单独的可执行任务家族,用于精细的视觉回顾、动态状态修订、互动-可知状态和经验转移。

blocks.en: Long-horizon multimodal memory evaluation. Long-form visual and conversational benchmarks expose memory operations that are difficult to study through a single embodied rollout. EgoMemReason evaluates entity-state evolution, temporally separated events, and recurring behavior patterns over week-long egocentric video ( Wang et al., 2026b ) . Mem-Gallery studies multimodal memory extraction, reasoning, and knowledge management across multi-session conversations ( Bei et al., 2026 ) . Together with EgoSchema, OpenEQA, LoCoMo, and LongMemEval ( Mangalam et al., 2023 ; Majumdar et al., 2024 ; Maharana et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) , these works provide controlled tests of long-range evidence integration. Their outputs are primarily answers or reconstructed knowledge, whereas embodied execution additionally requires retrieved evidence to determine actions and change the environment correctly.
blocks.zh: 长征多模式记忆评价. 长式视觉和对话基准暴露出难以通过单一的内存推出来研究的内存操作. EgoMemReason评价实体-状态演化,时间分离的事件,以及持续一周的自我中心视频中反复出现的行为模式(Wang等人,2026b). Mem-Gallery研究跨多会对话的多模式内存提取,推理和知识管理(Bei等人,2026年). 这些作品与EgoSchema,OpenEQA,LoCoMo,和LongMemEval(Mangalam等人,2023年;Majumdar等人,2024年;Maharana等人,2024年;Wu等人,2025年)一起,为远程证据集成提供了受控测试. 它们的产出主要是答案或重建知识,而具体执行则需要收集证据,以确定行动并正确改变环境。

blocks.en: Memory architectures for embodied control. Recent methods differ in what they store and how memory enters the control loop. Memo learns when to summarize and retrieve history for long-horizon embodied policies ( Gupta et al., 2025 ) . MemoryVLA combines working memory with a bank of perceptual detail and semantic content, while MEM represents short-range history with video and long-range task progress with language ( Shi et al., 2026 ; Torne et al., 2026 ) . STaR builds task-agnostic multimodal memory and retrieves a compact task-conditioned subset; HIMM separates episodic recall from reusable semantic rules for exploration and question answering ( Yuan et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . MemCompiler conditions memory selection on the agent’s current execution state, addressing the mismatch between static retrieved context and a changing task state ( Ding et al., 2026 ) . Affordance RAG further grounds retrieved visual memory in executable mobile-manipulation choices ( Korekata et al., 2025 ) . These systems motivate structured and selective memory, while EMem focuses on maintaining scene, spatial, and event records that jointly support the four challenges measured by EMem-Bench.
blocks.zh: 包含控件的内存架构 。 最近的方法在存储什么和内存如何进入控制循环上有所不同. Memo学会了何时总结和回溯长期政策的历史(Gupta等人,2025年)。 MemoryVLA将工作内存与知觉细节和语义内容库结合起来,而MEM则代表短程历史与视频和长程任务进展与语言(Shi等人,2026年;Torne等人,2026年). STaR构建任务不可知的多式联运内存并检索到一个紧凑的任务条件子集;HIMM将零星的召回与可重复使用的语义规则区分开来,用于探索和回答问题(袁等人,2026年;李等人,2026年). Memcompiller在代理执行状态上为内存选择条件,解决静态检索上下文与不断变化的任务状态之间的不匹配(Ding等人,2026年). Affonance RAG在可执行的移动操纵选择中进一步检索了视觉内存(Korekata等人,2025年)。 这些系统激发了结构化和选择性的内存,而EMem则侧重于维护场景,空间,事件记录,共同支持EMem-Bench测量的四项挑战.

blocks.en: Learning from interaction outcomes. Interaction creates information that is absent from passive observation. Memory-augmented manipulation methods use previous successes, failures, and corrections to adapt later decisions. In particular, MEMO aggregates local language corrections and successful executions into reusable guidance and skill templates for new tasks ( Christie et al., 2026 ) . This direction is closely related to the Interaction Failure and Experience Generalization families in EMem-Bench: the former tests whether an outcome updates the represented world state, and the latter tests whether recurring corrections yield a rule that transfers to an unseen object.
blocks.zh: 从互动结果中学习。 相互作用创造出被动观察中缺失的信息. 内存强化的操纵方法利用之前的成功,失败,以及修正来适应后来的决定. 特别是,MEMO将当地语言的校正和成功处决汇总为新任务可重复使用的指导和技能模板(Christie等人,2026年)。 这个方向与EMem-Bench的相互作用失败与经验概括化家族密切相关:前者测试一个结果是否更新了所代表的世界状态,后者测试反复出现的纠正是否产生一个规则,将它转移给一个看不见的对象.

blocks.en: Appendix B Embodied-Memorizer Details
blocks.zh: 附录B

blocks.en: This section expands the three-memory design in Section 5 and describes the implementation used in our experiments. EMem is deliberately modular: a policy decides what to write, what to retrieve, and how to act, while the memory backend performs deterministic record updates and searches. All memory is episode-local and is initialized empty for each trajectory.
blocks.zh: 本节扩展了第5节中的三模样设计,并描述了我们实验中使用的实施. EMem是故意模块化的:一个政策决定了写什么,检索什么,如何行动,而内存后端则执行决定性的记录更新和搜索. 所有内存均为插曲-局部,每个轨迹初始化为空.

blocks.en: B.1 Memory Representation
blocks.zh: B.1 记忆代表

blocks.en: At interaction step t t , EMem maintains ℳ t = ( 𝒢 t , ℰ t , 𝒞 t ) , \mathcal{M}_{t}=(\mathcal{G}_{t},\mathcal{E}_{t},\mathcal{C}_{t}), (3) where 𝒢 t \mathcal{G}_{t} , ℰ t \mathcal{E}_{t} , and 𝒞 t \mathcal{C}_{t} denote Spatial, Event, and Scene Memory, respectively. Each record contains an identifier, a write step, a scene scope, and links to the model-visible observation or interaction from which it was written. These shared fields let the three stores refer to the same experience without introducing a separate memory type.
blocks.zh: 在交互步骤 t 时, EMem 维护 M t = (G t, E t, C t ),\ mathcal{M}_{t}=(\mathcal{G}_{t},\mathcal{E}_{t},\mathcal{C}_{t}), (3) 其中 G t\mathcal{G}_{t}, Et\mathcal{E}_{t} 和 Ct\mathcal{C}_{t} 分别表示空间,事件,和场景记忆. 每张记录包含一个标识符,一个写步骤,一个场景范围,以及链接到其写作的模型可见的观察或交互. 这些共享的字段让三家商店在不引入单独内存类型的情况下提及同样的体验.

blocks.en: Spatial Memory. 𝒢 t \mathcal{G}_{t} is a scene-scoped entity graph. A node stores an entity name and type, its observable properties, and references to related event and scene records. Edges store relations such as in , on , held_by , and seen_in . Scene scope is part of the entity key, so similarly named objects in different rooms remain separate.
blocks.zh: 空间记忆. g t\ mathcal{G}_{t}是一个场景范围的实体图. 一个节点存储一个实体名称和类型,其可观测属性,以及相关事件和场景记录的引用. Edges存储关系如: in, on, hold_by, and seen_in. 场景范围是实体密钥的一部分,因此不同房间中类似命名的物体仍然单独存在.

blocks.en: Spatial Memory represents the latest known state rather than an unedited history of state descriptions. Relations are grouped into families that cannot hold simultaneously. For example, in , on , and held_by belong to the physical-location family. If a new record supports a relation r r for entity v v , EMem updates that family as R t ​ ( v ) = ( R t − 1 ​ ( v ) ∖ F ⁡ ( r ) ) ∪ { r } , R_{t}(v)=\bigl(R_{t-1}(v)\setminus F(r)\bigr)\cup\{r\}, (4) where F ⁡ ( r ) F(r) is the set of active relations that conflict with r r . Other relation families and compatible properties are preserved. Thus, observing a book on a desk replaces an earlier location on a bed without deleting unrelated information about the book.

blocks.en: Event Memory. ℰ t \mathcal{E}_{t} is an append-only sequence of action outcomes. A raw event stores the action, success flag, environment feedback, a short summary, its scene scope, and supporting identifiers. Both successful and failed interactions are retained. Consequently, feedback such as a locked drawer remains available even when that state was not visually observable.
blocks.zh: 事件记忆. E t \ mathcal{ E}_{t} 是仅作为附件的动作结果序列 。 一个原始事件存储了动作,成功的旗帜,环境反馈,一个简短的总结,它的场景范围,以及支持标识符. 成功和失败的相互作用都保留下来。 因此,即使无法看到这种状态,仍可得到诸如锁上抽屉之类的反馈。

blocks.en: Event Memory also stores a compact aggregate when several related corrections express the same regularity. The aggregate consists of a short natural-language rule and the identifiers of the raw events that support it. We form an aggregate after at least two related correction events; an explicit persistent failure can be retained after one event. Aggregation is part of Event Memory, rather than a separate “experience” store, and query_event can request either raw events or aggregate rules. This matches the design in the main paper: reusable experience is a summary over interaction events.
blocks.zh: 事件内存在几个相关更正表达相同的规律时也会存储一个紧凑的集合. 集合包含一个简短的自然语言规则以及支持它的原始事件的识别符. 我们至少经过两个相关的更正事件后形成一个汇总;在一个事件之后可以保留一个明显的持续失败. 聚合是事件记忆的一部分,而不是单独的“经验”商店,查询活动可以要求原始事件或集合规则。 这与主论文中的设计相匹配:可重复使用的经验是交互事件上的总结.

blocks.en: Scene Memory. 𝒞 t \mathcal{C}_{t} stores selected visual snapshots. Each record contains a model-generated caption, the entities identified by the model in that image, the scene scope, and a reference to the original RGB observation. The image reference is attached by the harness, so the model does not construct file paths. A practical admission gate suppresses near-duplicate snapshots while retaining views that add visual content, newly observed entities, or useful instance context. The entity list is extracted from the current RGB observation; it is not a simulator-provided inventory of all objects in the environment. Scene Memory therefore preserves visual detail, while Spatial Memory maintains the corresponding structured state.
blocks.zh: 场景记忆. C t\ mathcal{C}_{t} 存储选中的视觉快照 。 每张记录包含一个模型生成的字幕,模型在该图像中识别的实体,场景范围,以及参考原始RGB观察. 图像参考物由牵引装置附着,因此模型不会构造文件路径. 实用的录用门压制了近似重复的快照,同时保留了添加视觉内容,新观察到的实体,或者有用的实例上下文的视图. 实体列表是从当前RGB观测中提取的;它不是模拟器提供的环境中所有物体的目录. 因此,场景记忆保留了视觉细节,而空间记忆则保持了相应的结构状态.

blocks.en: B.3 Task-Conditioned Retrieval and Execution
blocks.zh: B.3 任务安排 检索和执行

blocks.en: When the target instruction becomes available, the policy enters a memory phase. It selects one or more of query_spatial , query_event , and query_scene according to the information needed by the instruction. Query arguments specify a natural-language information need and, where applicable, scene scope, temporal policy, event granularity, and a maximum number of records. The query must not presuppose its answer. Experience Generalization uses the same query_event interface as any other instruction and does not invoke a benchmark-specific tool.
blocks.zh: 目标指令可用后,政策进入内存阶段. 它根据指令所需的信息选择一个或多个查询_空间,查询_事件,查询_场景. 查询参数指定了自然语言信息需求,并在适用的情况下指定场景范围,时间政策,事件颗粒性,以及记录的最大数量. 查询决不能预先假定答案。 经验通论使用与其他指令相同的查询-事件接口,不引用特定基准工具.

blocks.en: Each query searches its associated store with the same deterministic pipeline. EMem first applies available structured constraints, including memory type, scene scope, entity name, relation, action, or event granularity. It then prioritizes exact structured matches, followed by lexical matches over record text. Semantic similarity is used only as a fallback when the earlier stages do not fill the requested record budget. The primary selected set is capped at 12 records; returned records also carry identifiers for their direct support when available. For a spatial query with the latest policy, newer records are preferred; persistent event feedback and aggregate rules are not discarded merely because they are old.
blocks.zh: 每个查询都用同一个确定性管道搜索其相关商店. EMem首先应用了可用的结构约束,包括内存类型,场景范围,实体名称,关系,动作,或事件颗粒性. 然后优先排列精确的结构匹配,然后是语法匹配而不是记录文本。 语义相似性仅在前期未填充所要求的记录预算时作为倒置. 首选的套装上限为12个记录;返回的记录还带有识别符,用于在可获得时直接支持. 对于有最新政策的空间查询,倾向于使用较新的记录;持续的事件反馈和汇总规则不会仅仅因为陈旧而被抛弃。

blocks.en: The retrieved records are inserted into the action context together with the instruction, current RGB observation, and current legal-action list. The policy then emits one ordered action_sequence . Before execution, every primitive is checked against the refreshed legal actions and its target must be grounded by the current interface or retrieved records. The environment executes accepted actions in order. A failed or unavailable action, or a sufficiently large change in the memory-backed state, interrupts the remaining sequence and starts a new memory–action turn. Algorithm 1 summarizes this procedure.
blocks.zh: 检索到的记录连同指示、目前的RGB观察和当前的法律行动清单一起插入行动上下文。 策略发出一个命令动作_序列 。 执行前,每个原始人都要与更新的法律行动核对,其目标必须基于当前接口或检索的记录. 环境按顺序执行已接受的行动。 一个失败或无法操作的动作,或内存支撑状态的足够大的变化,会打断剩余的序列并开始一个新的内存–动作转弯. 算法1总结了这一程序.

blocks.en: The runtime settings are fixed across benchmark families: the primitive-action budget is 8, the primary retrieval budget is at most 12 records per call, near-duplicate scenes use a cosine-similarity threshold of 0.995, and evaluation uses deterministic decoding. These values are not selected using benchmark-family labels.

blocks.en: B.5 Training Procedure
blocks.zh: B.5 培训程序

blocks.en: Teacher trajectories. We construct a household-interaction curriculum on the ProcTHOR training split. The sampled tasks cover navigation, object search, state inspection, manipulation, and correction-bearing interactions. A teacher model completes them through the same RGB observation, memory-tool, and action interfaces used at inference. Every trajectory begins with empty memory. During history ingestion, the teacher processes one chronological step at a time without receiving the later target task, and its valid write calls are executed before the next step. After the target is presented, the teacher queries memory and generates an ordered action sequence from the returned records. Training and evaluation use disjoint scenes and trajectories.
blocks.zh: 教师轨迹. 我们制定了关于ProcTHOR分期培训的家庭互动课程。 抽样任务包括导航、物体搜索、国家检查、操纵和带有校正的相互作用。 一个师范模型通过同样的RGB观测,内存工具,以及推论中使用的动作界面来完成它们. 每个轨迹都从空记忆开始. 在历史摄入过程中,老师一次处理一个时间顺序步骤,而不会收到后来的目标任务,其有效的写作呼叫在下一步之前执行. 目标呈现后,老师查询内存,并从返回的记录中生成一个命令动作序列. 训练和评价采用脱节场景和轨迹.

blocks.en: Supervision format. Each retained trajectory is serialized into three turn types: context-write turns (C), target-task memory turns (M), and action turns (A). A C target selects durable information supported by the current observation or feedback and writes it through Table 6 . An M target selects one or more of the three generic query tools. The following A target receives the executed query results and produces the grounded action sequence. Examples contain only the transcript prefix available at that point. Parent trajectories are assigned to a split before prefix expansion, ensuring that all turns from one trajectory remain in the same split. Schema validation removes outputs with an invalid phase, undeclared tool, missing argument, or malformed action sequence.
blocks.zh: 监督格式。 每个保留轨迹被序列化为三个转折类型:上下文-写入转折(C),目标任务内存转折(M),动作转折(A). C目标选择当前观察或反馈支持的持久信息,并通过表6写入. M目标选择三个通用查询工具中的一个或多个. 以下 A 目标接收已执行的查询结果并生成被基于的动作序列. 例子只包含当时可用的笔录前缀. 父轨迹被分配到前缀扩展前的分割,确保从一个轨迹中的所有转折都保持在同一分割中. Schema 校验会以无效的相位,未宣布的工具,缺失的参数,或错误的动作序列来删除输出.

blocks.en: This section specifies the evaluation interface used by the full_context baselines in Table 2 and expands the benchmark summary in Section 4 using the canonical Full-2554 release. We first describe exactly how the interaction history, current observation, and legal action space are exposed to a model, then report model-output trajectory lengths, benchmark composition and difficulty, object coverage, release audit results, and aggregation sensitivity. EMem-Bench contains 2,554 episodes across 1,118 globally unique scenes, 125 visible object types, 83 target object types, and 33 receptacle types. All family-level scene and category counts below are computed within that family and may overlap across families; they therefore should not be summed to recover the global unions.

blocks.en: C.2 Operational Definition of Error Recurrence Rate
blocks.zh: C.2 错误重复率的业务定义

blocks.en: ERR measures whether an agent reenacts a mistake that the preceding interaction history makes avoidable. It is computed automatically from the bound action trace and frozen probe annotations. Each released probe specifies the memory-dependent relation and, where applicable, one or more exact error triggers used by the evaluator.
blocks.zh: ERR度量剂是否重现了前一次相互作用历史可以避免的错误. 它从绑定的动作跟踪和冻结的探测记录中自动计算出来。 每个被释放的探针都指定了内存依赖关系,并在适用的情况下指定了评价者使用的一个或多个精确误差触发器.

blocks.en: Let the executed trace for episode i i be A i = ( a i , 1 , … , a i , L i ) A_{i}=(a_{i,1},\ldots,a_{i,L_{i}}) . After semantic targets have been rebound to the current legal action space, the evaluator compares every successfully executed action with the probe specification. For Passive Observation, ERR is triggered when the agent, before reaching the remembered object location, successfully navigates to a different semantic receptacle type that is inconsistent with the frozen target-location annotation. For Dynamic Tracking, it is triggered when the agent, before reaching the latest post-update location, successfully navigates to a different-type superseded or otherwise incorrect location. Both families accept physical-parent aliases such as Sink for SinkBasin ; a same-type alternative is left unpenalized because it may reflect instance grounding rather than recurrence of a memory error.

blocks.en: For Interaction Failure, ERR is triggered when the agent successfully repeats the exact action–target pair identified by the earlier failed interaction, such as opening the same known unusable container. For Experience Generalization, it is triggered when the agent successfully places the carried target object at a receptacle inconsistent with the frozen owner-habit rule and its executable target aliases. Together, these four deterministic rules identify recurrence of the family-specific avoidable error from simulator-bound semantic actions and frozen episode annotations.

blocks.en: The benchmark’s memory demand combines target-task execution with a long interaction history. Table 10 quantifies interaction-history difficulty, and Figure 10 reports visible-object density at the decisive cue and room/scene transitions. Experience Generalization is structurally the longest family, with a median of 111 interaction steps and four to five room/scene transitions. The other families have median histories of 78–83 steps and exactly two transitions, yet their median cue-to-target gaps remain comparably long at 52–56 steps. The cue itself is also visually nontrivial: Passive Observation contains 11.0 visible objects on average at the decisive cue, consistent with its fine-grained visual-memory focus. Interaction Failure has fewer visible objects because its decisive state is revealed by action feedback rather than appearance. Together with the main-paper results and the cue-removal controls in Section D , these statistics show that successful tasks require recovering decisive evidence across long, changing, and visually cluttered interaction histories.

blocks.en: C.5 Object Coverage and Distribution Concentration

blocks.en: Table 11 summarizes category breadth and concentration, complementing the global unions in Table 9 . Target-object concentration is low in Passive Observation, Dynamic Tracking, and Experience Generalization: their most frequent target accounts for only 11.0%, 9.6%, and 5.9% of family episodes. Interaction Failure is intentionally narrower, with 18 target types and five receptacle types, so its top-five shares are correspondingly higher. Receptacle distributions are more concentrated than target-object distributions because each task family admits only receptacles that support its executable terminal action. Overall, EMem-Bench covers a broad and nontrivially distributed set of objects and scenes while retaining the controlled object–receptacle support required by each task family.

blocks.en: We audit every retained episode before release. All 2,554 episodes belong to the canonical manifest, contain recoverable decisive evidence, execute successfully under the benchmark’s strict-oracle action contract, and reach the intended terminal task state. These automatic checks are paired with the six-dimensional manual review below, which covers evidence sufficiency, instruction clarity, answer or target leakage, trajectory plausibility, cue–probe alignment, and terminal-judgment correctness. Together, the construction and review pipeline rejected 143 candidates before retaining the final 2,554 episodes.

blocks.en: A panel of five domain experts performed manual screening at the candidate-episode level after the schema, duplication, cue-recovery, and strict-oracle gates and before admission to the frozen manifest. The reviewer first compared the probe instruction and simulator-defined terminal condition, and then traversed the complete context trajectory in chronological order. Figure 11 shows the benchmark-specific interface used to make long trajectories tractable. Its session map preserves scene and session boundaries; the global timeline retains every step and distinguishes context, distractor, and decisive-evidence steps; and the enlarged view aligns the RGB observation with the executed action, simulator feedback, visible-object list, agent pose, and held object. A construction-metadata highlight anchors the review to the task-defining cue. Reviewers cited global step indices to ground each concern or acceptance decision in recoverable evidence.
blocks.zh: 由5名域专家组成的小组在计划、重复、恢复和严格控制门之后,并在进入冻结清单之前,在候选-集束层进行人工筛选。 审查者首先比较了探测指令和模拟器定义的终端条件,然后按时间顺序穿越完整的上下文轨迹. 图11显示了用于使长轨可拉动的基准专用接口. 它的会话映射保存了场景和会话边界;全局时间线保留了每一个步骤,并区分了上下文,分心器,以及决定性的证据步骤;扩展视图将RGB观测与已执行的动作,模拟反馈,可见对象列表,代理设置,以及持有的对象相配合. 构建-元数据将审查定位到任务确定提示。 审查人员援引了全球步骤指数,以可收回的证据作为每项关切或接受决定的依据。

blocks.en: The manual review considered the six dimensions shown in the right panel of Figure 11 . Evidence sufficiency checked that the decisive object, state change, interaction outcome, or repeated household correction was recoverable from the recorded observation–action–feedback chain. Instruction clarity checked that the target task and its intended completion state were identifiable. No answer or target leakage checked that the later instruction and distractor content preserved dependence on the remembered location, outcome, or generalized rule established by the trajectory. Trajectory plausibility checked the consistency of scene transitions, executed actions, environment feedback, held-object state, and relevant object-state changes. Cue–probe alignment checked that the probe depended on the object instance, updated state, failed interaction, or experience pattern established by the earlier cue. Finally, terminal-judgment correctness checked the evaluator’s transition from the pending state to the intended completion state. Candidates with a material issue were corrected and rechecked or removed. This construction-and-screening process rejected 143 candidates and retained the 2,554 episodes reported in the main paper.
blocks.zh: 手册审查考虑了图11的正确面板所示的六个方面。 证据充足性检查了决定性对象、状态变化、互动结果或家庭反复纠正是否可从记录的观察-行动-反馈链中恢复。 指令清晰度检查了目标任务及其预期完成状态是否可识别。 没有任何答复或目标渗漏证实,后来的指示和分散注意力的内容保留了对所记位置、结果或轨迹所确立的普遍规则的依赖。 轨迹可信性检查了场景过渡的一致性,执行动作,环境反馈,持有对象状态,以及相关的对象状态变化. Cue- probe 校正检查该探测器是否依赖于对象实例、 更新状态、 失败的相互作用, 或先前的提示所建立的经验模式 。 最后,终审正确性检查了评估人员从待决状态过渡到预定完成状态的情况。 有重大问题的候选人得到纠正,重新检查或除名。 这一构建和筛选过程拒绝了143名候选人,并保留了主报报道的2,554集.

blocks.en: The second interface mode initializes the candidate’s probe through the same EmbodiedMemorizerEnv , legal-action generator, action executor, and EpisodeEvaluator used for benchmark evaluation. It presents the actions legal in the current simulator state, refreshes the RGB observation and object/agent state after every transition, and displays the evaluator’s task progress and task_completed value. The reviewer can replay the declared oracle path, inspect every action result, and reset a suspicious case to test an alternative legal path. This interactive audit establishes task executability and verifies the evaluator’s transition from pending progress to the intended terminal state.

blocks.en: Figures 13 and 14 provide paired success and failure examples from GPT-5.4-mini under the full_context protocol. blocks.en: We draw a fixed 800-episode subset from the canonical manifest, with 200 episodes per task family and balanced sampling over cue-to-task distance quartiles. blocks.en: The paired Correct-history minus Cue-removed macro-SR difference was 11.1 points for Qwen3-VL-8B (95% CI [8.1, 14.1]) and 21.4 points for GPT-5.4-mini (95% CI [17.8, 25.0]). Across cue-distance quartiles, the corresponding paired differences were Q1: 14.5, Q2: 10.5, Q3: 5.5, Q4: 14.0 points for Qwen3-VL-8B and Q1: 25.0, Q2: 18.0, Q3: 21.0, Q4: 21.5 points for GPT-5.4-mini. Taken together, these interventions establish the central validity claim of EMem-Bench: benchmark success genuinely requires memory of preceding interactions. With the target task and current environment state held fixed, removing the earlier sessions or only the decisive historical evidence sharply reduces macro SR; the tasks therefore cannot be solved from the current observation, generic scene priors, or ordinary embodied competence alone. The positive cue effect in every distance quartile confirms that this requirement extends to temporally remote evidence. Minimal oracle reaches 58.2 and 69.1 macro SR for Qwen3-VL-8B and GPT-5.4-mini, exceeding Current only by 47.4 and 58.1 points, respectively. It also exceeds Correct history by 34.4 and 32.5 points. These gaps show that both models can act much more effectively once the task-relevant past relation is recovered, separating the memory-retrieval challenge from downstream execution. Memory is therefore necessary information for solving EMem-Bench tasks.

blocks.en: When the complete visual history exceeds the provider limit, a deterministic sampler allocates frames uniformly across sessions and each session’s timeline, then restores them to temporal order. The resulting treatment augments the main-paper input with the maximum historical RGB sequence admitted by the model context. Image-token counts are computed with the model’s image processor.

blocks.en: Adding the maximum available historical RGB sequence changed macro SR by -10.4 points (95% CI [-14.4, -6.5]). The treatment admitted archived frames for all 800 episodes. The paired SR changes across history-length quartiles were Q1: -11.5, Q2: -8.5, Q3: -9.0, Q4: -12.5 points. Taken together, these results establish a broader conclusion: EMem-Bench cannot be solved by simply enlarging the raw multimodal context. Maximizing historical visual input reduced rather than improved macro SR, while increasing mean input from 41,770 to 206,489 tokens per episode and mean model-step latency from 4.1 to 39.1 seconds. The negative change in every history-length quartile shows that the degradation is systematic across history lengths. Additional observations are therefore insufficient for effective memory. Success requires precise retrieval of task-relevant evidence and suppression of irrelevant history; indiscriminate context accumulation instead dilutes the decisive signal. EMem-Bench consequently distinguishes long-term memory retrieval capability from mere context-window scaling.
blocks.zh: 添加最大可用的历史 RGB 序列将宏 SR 更改为 -10.4 点(95% CI [-14.4, -6.5]). 治疗接受了所有800发的存档帧. 成对的SR跨历史长方位变化为Q1:-11.5,Q2:-8.5,Q3:-9.0,Q4:-12.5分. 总之,这些结果得出了更广泛的结论: EMem-Bench不能简单地通过扩大原始多式联运背景来解决。 将历史视觉输入最大化减少了而不是改善了宏观SR,同时将平均输入从每集41,770个增加到206,489个令牌,并意味着模型步骤的延迟从4.1秒增加到39.1秒. 每个历史长度的四分位数的负变化表明,整个历史长度的退化是系统的。 因此,补充意见不足以有效记忆。 成功需要准确检索与任务相关的证据和压制无关的历史;不分青红皂白地积累背景会淡化决定性的信号。 EMem-Bench因此区分了长期内存检索能力与单纯的上下文窗口缩放.

blocks.en: Appendix E Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录E 限制

blocks.en: A limitation of this work is that EMem-Bench and the cross-benchmark evaluations are conducted primarily in simulation. Simulation allows us to control the earlier evidence, reproduce complete interactions, and score the resulting environment transitions while reducing the cost and safety risks of physical experiments. However, it does not capture sensor noise, actuation error, open-world changes, or ambiguous human feedback encountered in real deployments. The reported results therefore do not establish long-term memory performance on physical robots. Future work will extend the evaluation to longer time horizons and more realistic environments, including standardized real-robot test suites that preserve reproducibility while remaining practical and safe.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的一个局限是EMem-Bench和跨基准评价主要在模拟中进行. 模拟使我们能够控制早期的证据,复制完整的相互作用,并在减少物理实验的成本和安全风险的同时,对由此产生的环境过渡进行评分. 然而,它并不捕捉感应噪声,激活错误,开放世界的变化,或者在实际部署中遇到的模糊的人类反馈. 因此,所报告的结果不能确定物理机器人的长期记忆性能。 今后的工作将扩大评价的范围,使之包括更长的时间范围和更现实的环境,包括标准化的实际机器人测试套件,既能保持可复制性,又能保持实用和安全。
